boards.title: Your First Weekend at Middlebury College, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-pressure first-weekend sequence of campus landmarks, an outdoor option, and ways to find current programming.

cards.title: Start with Davis Family Library
cards.subtitle: Settle in on Storrs Avenue
cards.notes: Use the atrium as a meeting point, then choose a seat or reserve a study space while you get oriented to campus resources.
cards.short_summary: A spacious campus library with study rooms, service desks, and 725 seats.
cards.evidence_claim: Davis Family Library has 725 seats, group study rooms, service desks, classrooms, and technology and learning support offices.
cards.access_notes: The library is open to the public; after 7 p.m., doors open only to Middlebury faculty, staff, and students with ID. Check current hours before visiting.

cards.title: Take a quiet gallery lap
cards.subtitle: Inside the Mahaney Arts Center
cards.notes: Walk through the galleries at your own pace, then use the free digital guide if you want context for a work that catches your attention.
cards.short_summary: A free campus art museum with accessible galleries and a digital guide.
cards.evidence_claim: Admission to the Middlebury College Museum of Art is free, and it offers a free digital guide.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit | Middlebury College Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: Located at 72 Porter Field Road in the Mahaney Arts Center; current public hours are posted by the museum.

cards.title: Find the arts hub
cards.subtitle: The MAC, on the southeast edge of campus
cards.notes: Stop by the MAC plaza and check the arts calendar for an exhibition, recital, film, or performance that fits your weekend.
cards.short_summary: A campus arts center housing performance venues and the art museum.
cards.evidence_claim: The Mahaney Arts Center houses the museum, Seeler Studio Theatre, dance theatre, and Robison Hall, with performances and exhibitions during the academic year.
cards.access_notes: Consult the arts calendar or box office for event-specific access and ticket details.

cards.title: Get your bearings at McCullough
cards.subtitle: Student center and programming spaces
cards.notes: Meet up in the social space, scan posted programming, and locate the mail center, dining options, and Student Engagement offices for later.
cards.short_summary: A student center with event, performance, meeting, dining, and service spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: McCullough Student Center provides events, programming and meeting space, food services, the mail room, and performance spaces including Wilson Hall and Center Gallery.
cards.access_notes: Some rooms and performance spaces require scheduling or are reserved for programmed events.

cards.title: Check the MCAB calendar
cards.subtitle: Campus-wide student programming
cards.notes: Look for a current concert, film screening, speaker, or Winter Carnival event and confirm its location, timing, and entry details before heading out.
cards.short_summary: A student programming body that plans campus events across the academic year.
cards.evidence_claim: The Middlebury College Activities Board plans concerts, film screenings, speakers, and Winter Carnival programming.
cards.access_notes: Availability, venues, and any event requirements vary; use the current campus events listing.

cards.title: Plan a climbing-wall session
cards.subtitle: Peterson Family Athletics Complex
cards.notes: Complete the required waiver, ask a wall monitor about beginner options, and plan for a certification test if you want to belay.
cards.short_summary: A refurbished indoor wall offering bouldering, top-rope, and sport-lead climbing.
cards.evidence_claim: The wall is in Nelson Recreation Center and offers bouldering, top-rope, and sport-lead climbing; top-rope and lead belay require certification.
cards.access_notes: The official page says the wall is closed for the academic year and identifies fall reopening; verify the posted hours and waiver before going.

cards.title: Borrow gear for an outing
cards.subtitle: Middlebury Outdoor Programs
cards.notes: Ask the Gear Room staff what equipment fits your plan, then return borrowed items according to the program’s procedures after your outing.
cards.short_summary: A 2,000-square-foot equipment hub for Middlebury community members.
cards.evidence_claim: Middlebury Outdoor Programs describes its Gear Room as providing free use of outdoor equipment for the Middlebury community.
cards.access_notes: Equipment use is for the Middlebury community; confirm eligibility, availability, and checkout procedures with Outdoor Programs.

cards.title: Visit the campus garden
cards.subtitle: Route 125, just west of the College
cards.notes: Take a respectful daytime walk through the garden, yield to scheduled work, and check for volunteer hours or a campus-led activity.
cards.short_summary: A working garden and outdoor kitchen supporting learning, food, and community programs.
cards.evidence_claim: The Knoll offers an educational garden, outdoor kitchen, and serenity garden, and hosts gardening hours, internships, classes, and events.
cards.access_notes: Small casual gatherings are welcome, but guests should yield to staff, volunteers, and reserved groups; the site operates seasonally from roughly April 1 to November 1.

cards.title: Choose a TAM segment
cards.subtitle: 18-mile loop around the town of Middlebury
cards.notes: Pick a short, well-marked segment for daylight, bring water, and use one of the town access points rather than attempting the whole loop.
cards.short_summary: A multi-access trail loop through woods, fields, and Otter Creek scenery.
cards.evidence_claim: The Trail Around Middlebury is an 18-mile loop with multiple access points that circles town through forests, fields, and along Otter Creek.
cards.access_notes: Conditions, daylight, and trail surfaces vary by segment and season; select an appropriate route and prepare accordingly.

cards.title: See what the Panthers are playing
cards.subtitle: Middlebury College Athletics schedule
cards.notes: Use the official schedule to choose a home contest, confirm the venue and start time, and follow the event’s posted spectator guidance.
cards.short_summary: A chance to connect with current varsity competition across Middlebury’s sports facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: Middlebury Athletics publishes schedules for its varsity teams and lists campus athletic facilities and event information.
cards.access_notes: Schedules and spectator access change by sport and date; verify the specific event page before attending.
